title: Principal Fitting ideal gives generators after removing its torsion
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative local ring, let $M$ be a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and let $k\geq0$. Use the presentation-independent Fitting ideal $\operatorname{Fit}_k(M)$ of [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change]. If $\operatorname{Fit}_k(M)=(f)$ for $f\in A$, then $M/\{x\in M\mid fx=0\}$ can be generated by $k$ elements.
